memory_candidates.content: To exercise a cross-repo regression fixture (e.g. a second live repo's issues.jsonl) without deploying into that second repo: mirror a test suite's own scratch-root builder shape (mktemp -d; create <scratch>/.claude/scripts/lib/; copy the script under test plus its deploy-root-guard.sh and lib dependencies; write a minimal scratch specs/state.json naming the target projects; COPY ONLY, never move or edit, the real fixture files from the other repo). This removes cross-repo deploy risk entirely and lets expected output figures be derived exactly from the real fixture data at plan time.

When a full gate-set run (verify-deploy.sh / run-all.sh) surfaces a failure outside the current task's declared file scope, do not assume it is a regression from the current edits: (1) re-run the specific failing check/suite standalone, isolated from the full parallel battery, to rule out a parallelism flake; (2) grep for the same finding text across sibling tasks' issues.jsonl to check whether it is already filed as pre-existing; (3) for a fixture-based test, reproduce the fixture by hand to confirm the SAME root-cause finding appears, rather than assuming correlation. Only after this triage does a Reasoned Exclusions record (status-markers.md's five-condition test) apply; a bare 'pre-existing, not my scope' claim without re-running and cross-referencing is not sufficient evidence.
